name: severe-on-internal-value

finding.title: `push` writes one slot past the ring buffer
finding.description: `slot` is taken modulo `self.buf.len() + 1`, so it reaches `self.buf.len()` once the head reaches the last slot. `get_unchecked_mut(slot)` then writes past the end of the buffer, which is undefined behaviour and corrupts the memory after it.
